tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The default tint (AccentColor). The user can pick another accent, so tint with the system tint, never this literal. Links, toolbar glyphs, verification codes, and the All tile circle. Text on card: 4.87:1 light, 6.16:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: The tint at 12% (light) or 27% (dark). Grounds for accent badges and the passkey and code circles on entry rows. accent on it: about 4.2:1 light, 4.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Glyphs and labels on a filled accent capsule (the system's prominent glass button). 4.87:1 light; only 2.76:1 on the dark accent, which the system button handles with its own glass treatment.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards: the iOS grouped background (systemGroupedBackground). Use the system color in code; it is listed here so previews can paint it.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards on ground: list sections, home tiles, the failure card's base.

tokens.name: card-2
tokens.usage: A well inside a card: entry icon grounds behind favicons and standard icons, the verification code box.

tokens.name: card-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on the iPad sidebar, whose dark ground is as dark as card.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Neutral fills: empty strength-meter segments and the warning badge ground.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text (the system label color) on card, card-2 and ground.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Usernames, file names, summaries, counts, footers. On card 5.06:1 light, 5.94:1 dark; on ground 4.53:1 light, 7.33:1 dark.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside a card (the system opaque separator). Dividers start under the row's text, not under its icon.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Good and Very good strength segments and rating. As text on card it is only 2.22:1 in light (8.42:1 dark): the source keeps it, so pair it with the filled meter and never let the color carry the meaning alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Sync and access notices, the read-only toolbar glyph, the needs-attention dot, warning badges. Text on card 3.88:1 light (below 4.5:1 for small text), 8.28:1 dark; on fill 3.21:1 light.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, the Expired badge, and the unlock failure card's icon and border. Text on card 5.38:1 light, 4.99:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the Expired badge and the unlock failure card. danger on it: 4.71:1 light, 4.69:1 dark.

tokens.name: digit
tokens.usage: Digits in a revealed or generated password, and the 0–9 sample in the generator. 3.88:1 on card in light (passes only at the 22pt password size), 7.79:1 dark.

tokens.name: symbol
tokens.usage: Symbols in a revealed or generated password, and the !#$& sample. 2.95:1 on card in light (below the 3:1 large-text floor), 8.28:1 dark; letters stay label, so the password still reads.

tokens.name: tile-codes
tokens.usage: Verification Codes tile circle. Same in both themes. White glyph on it is 1.73:1: the glyph is decorative, the tile's title says what it is.

tokens.name: tile-tags
tokens.usage: Tags tile circle and one of the monogram tints. White on it: 4.13:1.

tokens.name: tile-trash
tokens.usage: Recycle Bin tile circle and one of the monogram tints. White glyph on it is 2.36:1; decorative, as above.

tokens.name: tile-glyph
tokens.usage: Glyphs on tile circles and monogram letters. Stays white in dark mode.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The app icon's ground (KeeForge.icon fill). Brand marks only, never UI chrome.

tokens.name: brand-key
tokens.usage: The app icon's key. Brand marks only. On brand-ink: 5.0:1.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Root screen titles (Databases, the vault root) via the system large title. Never set by hand.

styles.name: entry-title
styles.usage: Theme.Font.entryTitle (.title bold): the entry name under its header icon.

styles.name: tile-count
styles.usage: Theme.Font.tileCount (.title3, monospaced digits): counts on home tiles, in label-secondary.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Theme.Font.rowTitle (.headline): entry and database names, tile titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: .body: row labels, field values, the failure card's summary.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Theme.Font.subhead (.subheadline): usernames, file names, settings summaries, strength rows.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Theme.Font.footnote: folder paths on entry rows, section footers.

styles.name: caption-2
styles.usage: .caption2 monospaced digits: seconds inside the countdown ring.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Theme.Font.badge (.caption2 bold, uppercased): status badge text.

styles.name: code-large
styles.usage: Theme.Font.codeLarge: the verification code on the Codes list, in the tint.

styles.name: password
styles.usage: Theme.Font.password: the generator's suggestion, letters in label, digits in digit, symbols in symbol.

styles.name: code-row
styles.usage: Theme.Font.codeRow: the verification code row in entry details.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: Password fields and revealed values in rows (.body monospaced).

styles.name: error-code
styles.usage: .footnote monospaced: the error code on the failure card, in label-secondary.

styles.name: monogram
styles.usage: Monogram letters: rounded bold at 0.38 of the icon side (15pt on the 40pt row icon, 24pt on the 64pt header icon).

tokens.name: space-text-line
tokens.usage: Between the stacked lines of one row: title, username, path.

tokens.name: space-meter-segment
tokens.usage: Between strength-meter segments.

tokens.name: space-badge-gap
tokens.usage: Between badges, and between a failure card's text lines.

tokens.name: space-tile-gap
tokens.usage: Between home tiles, and inside a tile between the circle row and the title.

tokens.name: space-icon-text
tokens.usage: Between a row's icon and its text; between a code and its ring.

tokens.name: space-card-gap
tokens.usage: Between stacked cards outside a List.

tokens.name: space-tile-y
tokens.usage: Home tile top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-tile-x
tokens.usage: Home tile leading and trailing padding.

tokens.name: space-side
tokens.usage: Screen side margin and the failure card's padding. Lists get it from the system inset-grouped style.

tokens.name: space-badge-y
tokens.usage: Status badge top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-badge-x
tokens.usage: Status badge leading and trailing padding.

tokens.name: radius-entry-icon
tokens.usage: The verification code box. Entry icons use 0.25 of their side instead (10pt at 40pt, 16pt at 64pt).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Home tiles and the failure card, continuous corners. List sections get their corners from the system.

tokens.name: radius-capsule
tokens.usage: Badges, the row badge circles, and system capsule buttons.

tokens.name: size-meter-segment-h
tokens.usage: Strength meter segment height.

tokens.name: size-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring width on custom controls.

tokens.name: size-status-dot
tokens.usage: The needs-attention dot on settings hub rows, scaled with subheadline.

tokens.name: size-meter-segment-w
tokens.usage: Strength meter segment width, scaled with subheadline.

tokens.name: size-badge
tokens.usage: Passkey and code circles on entry rows; the countdown ring.

tokens.name: size-tile-circle
tokens.usage: The colored circle on a home tile, scaled with body.

tokens.name: size-entry-icon
tokens.usage: Entry icon in a row, scaled with body.

tokens.name: size-nav-button
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for bar buttons (the system glass buttons already meet it).

tokens.name: size-unlock-field
tokens.usage: Unlock password field height.

tokens.name: size-failure-badge
tokens.usage: Badge on a full unlock failure page.

tokens.name: size-entry-header-icon
tokens.usage: Entry icon at the top of entry details.

tokens.name: size-tile
tokens.usage: Home tile minimum height.
